title: Gluten-Free Yeast-Raised Hake Pie
description: A unique and flavorful pie dish made with hake, subtly influenced by Indian spices and a gluten-free crust.

ingredients.name: Indian spices
ingredients.notes: Blend of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

ingredients.name: Pie crust mix (gluten-free)
ingredients.notes: Make sure the mix is gluten-free

instructions: Prepare the pie crust mix according to the package instructions, using a gluten-free liquid.
Mix the Indian spices and quietly fermented yeast, then rub it onto the hake fillets.
Place the hake fillets in the pie crust, leaving a small border around the edges.
Brush the melted ghee or oil onto the crust edges to prevent burning.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the fish is cooked through.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
